summary.en: Expanded structures, concept albums, instrumental ambition.
summary.zh: 结构扩张、概念专辑与演奏野心。

body.en: Prog refuses the three-minute single's industrial tempo, pulling classical, jazz, and literary themes into rock. King Crimson and Pink Floyd model two expansions: sharp structural experiment and immersive sonic narrative.
body.zh: Prog 拒绝「三分钟单曲」的工业节奏，把古典、爵士与文学主题拉进摇滚。King Crimson 与 Pink Floyd 代表了两种不同的扩张路径：锋利的结构实验与沉浸的声景叙事。
